name: Voronoi Shatter
desc: A coarse Worley distance-field where two-dozen drifting seed sites partition the plane into breathing polygonal cells, colored per-cell from an iq cosine palette with F2-minus-F1 crack-lines fracturing the frame like stained glass, cracked earth, iridescent soap foam, neon distance-field veins, or a white-on-blue blueprint.

density.doc: number of cell sites (8..44) — more = finer shatter

crack.doc: crack-line width/prominence at the F2-F1 boundary

warp.doc: organic wobble + domain-warp crinkle of cell boundaries

scale.doc: feature zoom about the anchor (bigger = larger cells)

style.doc: render philosophy: leaded jewel glass / ochre desert plates / iridescent thin-film foam / neon distance-field veins on black (abstract) / white cracks on blueprint blue (mono, abstract)

seed.doc: deterministic site layout, velocities and hues
